items.q: Do I have to follow the plan exactly?
items.a: No. Treat it as a month-long outline, swap days to match events and sales, and replace ideas that do not fit your brand.

items.q: How do I measure whether the plan is working?
items.a: Track saves, shares, replies and enquiries, not just likes, and review them at the end of the 30 days.

items.q: Is my plan stored on your server?
items.a: No. It runs inside your browser, so what you type stays on your device and is not sent to us.

items.q: Can your team run my social media every month?
items.a: Yes. Our social media team handles calendars, creative, posting and monthly reports.
